name: Gearbox
text: I’ll run a targeted search for the latest high-power excavator attachments and hybrid power systems. I’ll pull specs from Caterpillar’s H-Series and Komatsu’s PC210LC-11 upgrade docs, then cross-check with Volvo’s ECR255E SR hybrid model—all stored in `/power/attachments/2024/` on the shared drive. I’ll run `grep -r "kW" *` to extract power metrics and `diff` against our current EXCAVA baseline in `/power/excava_specs.json`. Once I have the numbers, I’ll draft a 1-page comparison in `/power/decision/excava_upgrade_0.5pct.md` and ping the lead for sign-off.

name: Torque
text: Torque: Gearbox’s plan is textbook—digging specs from brochures and hybrid press releases won’t raise EXCAVA’s real-world cycle time by 0.5%. Where’s the field data? Volvo’s ECR255E SR hybrid claims 20% fuel savings in Volvo’s controlled demo, but the same whitepaper admits 8% productivity loss when digging abrasive granite. Caterpillar’s H-Series and Komatsu’s PC210LC-11 upgrades? Their “high-power” attachments are still diesel-only; the hybrid option isn’t even slated for release until Q3. Show me the field logs, not the marketing slides—otherwise this is just wishful spec-chasing.
